units.text: The 2026 Winter Olympics in Italy saw 10 Olympic records and 1 World record set, according to official reports from the International Olympic Committee and ISU.

citations.title: World and Olympic records set at the 2026 Winter Olympics - Wikipedia

judgement.reason: The passages support that 10 Olympic records and 1 World record were set at the 2026 Winter Olympics in Italy, but they do not attribute this to official reports from the International Olympic Committee or ISU.

units.text: The claim that 14 Olympic records were broken is contradicted by the documented total of 10 Olympic records set during the event.

citations.title: World and Olympic records set at the 2026 Winter Olympics - Wikipedia

judgement.reason: The passage explicitly documents 10 Olympic records set at the event, which directly contradicts a claim of 14 Olympic records being broken.
